regime_context: Detector paints Tech Hardware & Semis as the dominant narrative with moderate durability but low breadth (0.167), while eligibility concentrates in five themes (High-Dividend Blue Chips, Industrials, Tech Hardware, Conglomerates, Banks). The absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdown on this market (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional momentum has no return-forecast edge. The only scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) rank low and are ineligible, reflecting pronounced weakness.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Among eligible themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips shows the strongest durability (0.72) and broadest participation (breadth 0.875) with a trending tag, and no crowding. With gate_helps true, staying in eligible, high-durability trends aligns with the only validated edge (drawdown avoidance), not a return forecast. A modest positive lean is warranted as long as trend health persists.
theses.dissent: The theme ranks only 6th by momentum score (0.34) and is an income-oriented group; a sudden rate shock or rotation into growth could reverse its trend abruptly.

falsifier.text: If durability_bar drops below 0.60 or breadth falls below 0.70 within 10 trading days, the trend health has deteriorated.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: Ineligible (not passing the trend gate), with very low durability (0.30) and narrow breadth (0.26). Its ETF proxy (3033.HK) makes this scorable. Avoiding themes that fail the absolute-trend gate is consistent with the detector’s validated risk-control function, even if it lacks return-forecast power.
theses.dissent: Mean-reversion rallies can be sharp; the gate may filter out attractive oversold bounces, and the theme is a large benchmark component that can rally on macro shifts absent internal trend.

falsifier.text: If eligibility flips to true AND durability_bar rises above 0.50 within 15 trading days, the avoid stance is contradicted.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Ineligible, with low durability (0.37) and poor breadth (0.33). Like China Tech & Internet, it is scorable via 3033.HK but ranks near the bottom. Its trend is not robust enough to meet the gate’s drawdown-control threshold.
theses.dissent: Platform names benefit disproportionately from any China stimulus or AI narrative; the gate could miss a powerful re-rating rally that begins with a low-durability trend.

falsifier.text: If eligibility flips to true AND durability_bar exceeds 0.55 within 20 trading days, the avoid case weakens.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
